svg.title: Porcelain
svg.desc:
The Porcelain P: a lane that branches at the top, bowls out and rejoins, with a commit node on it.
VS Code paints these as a CSS mask, so only the alpha survives and the theme supplies the colour. The node is where the full-colour logo puts it at the bowl's junction, but three strokes already converge there and at 24px its counter closes against the bowl's own. On the lane's end it has room, so it sits there and the idea survives the size.
